import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for the source CSV files
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: Contains 2017 data only, no Region column
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Rename columns in df0 to match target suffix _17 exactly
    # Source0 columns: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    #                  'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']
    # They already match target suffix _17, so no rename needed except ensure consistent capitalization if any

    # Load Source 1: Contains 2015 data + Region, but column names differ and no 2017 data
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Rename Source1 columns to target schema for 2015 data with suffix _15
    df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
        'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
        'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
        'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
        'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
        'Family': 'Family_15',
        'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
        'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
        'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
        'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
        'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
    })

    # Select only needed columns from df1_renamed (all except 2017 columns)
    df1_selected = df1_renamed[['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
                               'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
                               'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15']]

    # Merge df1_selected (2015 data + Region) with df0 (2017 data) on 'Country'
    # This join will bring together 2015 and 2017 data for the same countries
    df_merged = pd.merge(df1_selected, df0, on='Country', how='inner')

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = [
        'Country', 'Region',
        'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
        'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
        'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
        'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]

    # Ensure all target columns exist in df_merged
    missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(df_merged.columns)
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

    df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Cast columns to correct types as per target schema
    # String columns: 'Country', 'Region'
    df_final['Country'] = df_final['Country'].astype(str)
    df_final['Region'] = df_final['Region'].astype(str)

    # Integer columns: 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17'
    df_final['Happiness_Rank_15'] = df_final['Happiness_Rank_15'].astype(int)
    df_final['Happiness_Rank_17'] = df_final['Happiness_Rank_17'].astype(int)

    # Float columns: all others except Country and Region and the two rank columns
    float_columns = [
        'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15',
        'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
        'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17', 'Family_17',
        'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
    ]
    for col in float_columns:
        df_final[col] = df_final[col].astype(float)

    # Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
    df_final.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
